description: The plot illustrates the relationship between Initial Confidence and Accuracy, with the x-axis labeled "Initial Confidence" and ranging from 0.91 to 0.98 in increments of 0.01 on a linear scale, and the y-axis labeled "Accuracy" and ranging from 0.0 to 1.0 in increments of 0.2 on a linear scale. Three lines are depicted: a solid blue line representing one trend, an orange dashed line representing another, and a green dash-dotted line representing a third. The blue line starts at approximately 0.84 on the y-axis at an Initial Confidence of 0.91, peaks at around 0.98 at 0.92, remains relatively steady at around 0.96-0.97 from 0.93 to 0.98. The orange dashed line begins at around 0.67 at 0.91, peaks at approximately 0.9 at 0.92, and then declines to around 0.12 at 0.98. The green dash-dotted line starts at about 0.22 at 0.91, decreases slightly to around 0.1 at 0.92, and then increases steadily to approximately 0.87 at 0.98.
